inventory_missing: Not recorded. The original was not read retrospectively.
archive_note: Hashes of the completed archive, if available.
archive_embedded: The completed ZIP hash is in the separately downloadable completion report; no self-referential archive hash.
title: Completion report
heading: {workspace} – Completion report
hash_notice: Local hashes document file state. Review forensic results manually.
list_notice: HTML displays at most 2,000 entries per file list. The accompanying JSON file contains the complete recorded data.
static_notice: Completed refers only to the stated inspection scope. No malware diagnosis or clean bill of health. Hashes cover the entire input file; entropy covers the first MiB.
inspector.metadata.name: Metadata and entropy
inspector.strings.name: Raw string search
inspector.strings.scope: Raw text from the first 8 MiB
inspector.pdf.name: PDF name search
inspector.pdf.scope: Literal names from the first 16 MiB
inspector.office.name: Office directory
inspector.pe.name: PE headers
inspector.pe.scope: Headers and section table, without code analysis
inspector.unknown.name: Unknown inspection
office.ooxml_scope: OOXML central directory, without extraction or content analysis
limitation.default: Bounded static inspection; indicators are neither a malware diagnosis nor a clean bill of health.
limitation.scope: Static raw data inspection only. No execution, rendering, macros or internet access. Indicators are neither a malware diagnosis nor a clean bill of health.
limitation.ole: Legacy OLE contents are not parsed in 0.25; an oleid adapter is planned. No conclusions about macros.
limitation.ooxml: Directory names and declared sizes only; no extraction, XML, macro or relationship analysis. Names are unverified metadata.
limitation.pe: No DLL loading, import resolution, signature validation or disassembly. Timestamps may be manipulated.
limitation.entropy: Entropy covers only the first MiB; high entropy alone does not prove malware.
limitation.strings: Raw text from the first 8 MiB only; do not open URLs or execute contents.
limitation.pdf: Literal names; comments and strings may also be counted. Compressed/encrypted contents are not evaluated. No replacement for PDFID, no malware assessment.
inventory.scope: Heuristic overview of files recorded in the extracted ZIP; no proof of presence or absence on the original device.
extended.imports_scope: Normal declared imports only; no delay-load or dependency resolution, no DLL loading.
extended.resources_scope: Bounded tree and range metadata only; resources are not opened or extracted.
extended.overlay_scope: Structural file ranges, without signature validity or trust verification. Uncertain ranges leave the overlay size unknown.
extended.indicators_scope: From already extracted bounded raw strings only. No complete file scan, network resolution or malware verdict.
extended.module_scope: Only directly and unambiguously resolved module/helper files at capture time. No complete dependency resolution; unresolved entries remain visible. Checking hashes before tool startup is not continuous isolation.
extended.display_limit: View limited to 500 functions or 200 resources. Raw details are in the associated JSON report.
extended.indicator_display_limit: View: first 200 indicators. The separate JSON export contains the complete captured bounded snapshot.
extended.snapshot_limit: PE detail snapshot limited to 8 inspection steps or 2 MiB; the individual reports retain their raw details.
extended.no_capture: Not captured for this job. Earlier jobs are not read again.
